zsfm-rs

Rust workspace for zero-shot forecasting and tabular foundation models — GGUF conversion plus candle inference engines, one zsfm CLI for every model.

Guide → How to install the CLI, convert a model, and run inference — with real request/response examples for every model. API reference → Generated rustdoc for every crate in the workspace.

CLI

zsfm-cliThe `zsfm` binary — convert / infer / upload for every model

Shared infrastructure

zsfm-coreTraits, JSON envelope, config helpers zsfm-ggufGGUF reader/writer zsfm-hubHuggingFace Hub download/upload zsfm-nnShared candle tensor primitives zsfm-checkpointFormat-agnostic checkpoint reader + dtype casting

Tabular foundation models

zsfm-mitraAutoGluon Mitra (Tab2D) zsfm-tabdptTabDPT zsfm-tabiclTabICL v2 zsfm-tabpfnTabPFN-3 (non-commercial weights) zsfm-tabfmGoogle TabFM, full ensemble pipeline

zsfm-totoDatadog Toto-2 zsfm-chronosAmazon Chronos-2 zsfm-timesfmGoogle TimesFM 2.5 zsfm-sundialSundial (flow-matching) zsfm-ttmIBM Granite TTM zsfm-lag-llamaLag-Llama zsfm-momentMOMENT-1-large zsfm-moiraiSalesforce Moirai 1.0 zsfm-moirai2Salesforce Moirai 2.0 zsfm-flowstateIBM Granite FlowState-R1 zsfm-tirexNX-AI TiRex
